{{Current events|year=2019|month=12|day=4|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–present)]]
**[[Japanese people|Japanese]] [[physician|doctor]] [[Tetsu Nakamura]] and five [[Afghans]] are killed in [[Jalalabad]], [[Nangarhar Province]], [[Afghanistan]] when militants [[mass shooting|open fire]] on their car while they were travelling to monitor a project. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-50654985 (BBC)] [https://www.euronews.com/2019/12/04/japanese-doctor-killed-attack-mourned-one-afghanistan-s-greatest-friends-n1095301 (Euronews)]
*[[Syrian Civil War]], [[Iran–Israel proxy conflict]]
**An [[Iran]]ian [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps]] weapons depot in [[Abu Kamal District]], [[Deir ez-Zor Governorate]], [[Syria]], is hit by an [[airstrike]]. Arab media say [[Israel]] is behind the attack. The [[United States]] denies any involvement. [https://www.ynetnews.com/article/B1v3mKS6H (Ynet)] [https://www.haaretz.com/middle-east-news/iran/iranian-weapons-warehouse-struck-in-northern-syria-report-says-1.8223997 (Haaretz)]
*In [[Madrid]], [[Spain]], a man throws a hand [[grenade]] at a [[immigration to Spain|migrant]] [[unaccompanied minor]] centre, although it did not explode. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/dec/04/grenade-thrown-at-migrant-childrens-centre-in-madrid (''The Guardian'')]
*Eighteen [[Indian people|Indian]] sailors are [[kidnapping|abducted]] near the [[Nigeria]]n coast. [https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/18-indians-on-board-hong-kong-vessel-kidnapped-off-nigerian-coast-ship-tracking-agency/article30172117.ece (The Hindu)]

;Arts and culture
*[[Gadhimai festival]]
**Thousands of [[animal sacrifice|animals are sacrificed]] by [[decapitation|beheading]] at the [[Hinduism|Hindu]] [[Gadhimai Temple]] in southern [[Nepal]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-nepal-religion/thousands-of-animals-sacrificed-in-nepal-hindu-ritual-amid-outcry-idUSKBN1Y81R6 (Reuters)]

;Disasters and accidents
*A boat carrying refugees capsized near [[Nouadhibou]], off the coast of [[Mauritania]], in one of the deadliest [[maritime disasters]] this year, leaving 58 people dead and many more who tried to swim to shore in need of treatment. The boat had departed [[The Gambia]] on 27 November 2019. It was heading towards the [[Canary Islands]] when it approached the Mauritanian coast to get fuel and food. The boat had been carrying between 150–180 people when it capsized, most of them aged between 20 and 30. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/dec/05/dozens-killed-as-migrant-boat-sinks-off-mauritania-coast (The Guardian)]
* A gas explosion in [[Szczyrk]], [[Poland]] causes a three-story building to collapse and kills 8 people [https://www.tvn24.pl/tvn24-news-in-english,157,m/poland-eight-people-dead-in-tragic-home-gas-explosion,990696.html (tvn24.pl)]

;Health and environment
*[[2019 Samoa measles outbreak]]
**Amid the imposed curfew, the [[Samoan government]] asks unvaccinated families to display a red flag or red cloth in front of their homes to warn others and to aid mass [[vaccination]] efforts as the death toll hits 60 and confirmed cases surpass 4,000. [https://www.dw.com/en/samoan-measles-epidemic-unvaccinated-advised-to-display-red-flags-in-front-of-their-homes/a-51520869 (Deutsche Welle)]

;International relations
*[[Japan–United States relations]]
**The [[National Diet]] of [[Japan]] ratifies a [[United States]]–Japan [[trade deal]]. Under the deal, Japan will reduce its tariffs on U.S. beef and pork; in return, Japan will receive reductions in tariffs on certain manufactured goods. [https://www.ft.com/content/01240552-166d-11ea-9ee4-11f260415385 (Financial Times)]
*[[Iran–United States relations]], [[Iran and weapons of mass destruction]]
**[[The Pentagon]] says the [[United States Navy]]'s [[USS Forrest Sherman (DDG-98)|USS ''Forrest Sherman'' (DDG-98)]] intercepted a vessel in the [[Arabian Sea]] last month and seized advanced missile parts that were of [[Iran]]ian origin. The crew were handed over to the [[Yemen Coast Guard]], while the missile parts are in the possession of the [[United States military]]. [https://reuters.com/article/uk-usa-iran-missiles-military/u-s-warship-in-gulf-seizes-missile-parts-of-suspected-iran-origin-idUKKBN1Y82S6?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Law and crime
*[[Crime in Hawaii]]
**The [[United States Armed Forces|U.S. military]] says a [[United States Navy|sailor]] shot and killed two people at [[Joint Base Pearl Harbor–Hickam]], [[Hawaii]], before killing himself. [https://www.upi.com/Top_News/US/2019/12/04/3-killed-including-gunman-in-Pearl-Harbor-shipyard-shooting/5351575510428/ (UPI)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Impeachment inquiry against Donald Trump]]
**The [[United States House Committee on the Judiciary|U.S. House Judiciary Committee]] begins its hearings into the [[Impeachment in the United States|impeachment]] inquiry of [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2019/12/04/us/politics/impeachment-hearings.html (''The New York Times'')]

*''[[Nunes v. CNN]]''
**U.S. Rep. [[Devin Nunes]] files a [[US$]]435 million defamation lawsuit against [[CNN]]. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/politics/2019/12/04/devin-nunes-files-435-million-defamation-lawsuit-against-cnn/2606359001/ (''USA Today'')]
